text:
Priya: Launch day recap 1: posted the benchmark narrative + launch thread at 07:30. Need a microexperiment for webinar registrants and inbound leads to validate which activation path scales: credits-first, templates-first, or checklist-first. Target: +5pp activation in 10 days.

Ethan: I like a 3x split randomized by signup_id. Quick proposal:
- Arm 1 (credits-first): 40 credits on signup + starter prompt modal
- Arm 2 (templates-first): zero credits + highlighted prompt packs in tray
- Arm 3 (checklist-first): zero credits + checklist + 15-min how-to video nudge
Traffic split 33/33/34. Keep credit caps at 5k.

Nora: Measurement notes: primary = pct_activated_first_10_tokens, secondary = avg_time_to_second_request. Events: signup.source, credit_grant, prompt_use, generation.success, video_play. I'll own the SQL and dashboard.

Caleb: Routing: inbound leads from the launch post should tag `launch_blitz_2026`. We can route them to onboarding_flow_v3. Eng needs to add mapping: source=="launch_post" and utm_campaign=="starter_bench" -> onboarding_flow_v3.

Priya: Copy/subject experimentation too. Ethan can you draft 2 subject lines per arm so we can A/B within arms? Keep them concise.

Ethan: Yep. Drafts incoming: "Starter Pack: 40 free credits to try" (credits), "10 prompt packs to ship faster" (templates), "Checklist + short demo to get live" (checklist). Will post full body copy.

CI Bot: PR created #905: onboarding_flow_v3 routing rule. Staging tests passed.

Nora: QA checklist before flip: cohort tag applied, credit idempotency verified, sample 100 users per arm validated, dashboard pulses firing. I'll run smoke at 11:00 PT.

Priya: Timeline: aim to flip at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Owners: Ethan (copy + cadence), Nora (measurement + QA), Caleb (routing + eng follow-up). Budget: credits cap 5k, per-user cap 40, TTL 21d.

Caleb: I'll follow up with eng for rate-limiting guardrails. Also adding an emergency rollback path to route everyone back to control.

Priya: Thanks team 1. Post any blockers here; will do a quick 10-min sync at 15:00 if needed. :rocket:
